key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show Global Menu
key.description: Master toggle for the whole global menu bar.

key.name: menu-app-enabled
key.summary: Show App menu

key.name: menu-file-enabled
key.summary: Show File menu

key.name: menu-edit-enabled
key.summary: Show Edit menu

key.name: menu-view-enabled
key.summary: Show View menu

key.name: menu-go-enabled
key.summary: Show Go menu

key.name: menu-window-enabled
key.summary: Show Window menu

key.name: menu-help-enabled
key.summary: Show Help menu

key.name: custom-menus
key.summary: JSON list of custom menu sections
key.description: Each entry: {label, enabled, items: [{label, kind: "command"|"shortcut", value}]}. Supports any number of independent custom top-level menus.

key.name: show-logo-menu
key.summary: Show the System Menu button

key.name: logo-icon-name
key.summary: System icon name for the System Menu button

key.name: logo-custom-icon-path
key.summary: Path to a custom icon file for the System Menu button
key.description: Highest priority: when non-empty, overrides everything else.

key.name: logo-distro-icon
key.summary: Bundled distro icon stem (e.g. "pear", "fedora", "arch"), empty for none

key.name: logo-distro-icon-symbolic
key.summary: Use the symbolic (single-color) variant of the bundled distro icon

key.name: logo-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size in pixels for the System Menu button

key.name: system-menu-font-size
key.summary: Type size of the System Menu, in pixels
key.description: The pear menu only. File, Edit and the rest of the bar have their own size. 13 is GNOME's own menu size.

key.name: menu-bar-font-size
key.summary: Type size of File, Edit and the other bar menus, in pixels
key.description: The titles in the bar, and the menus they open. The pear menu has its own size. 13 is GNOME's own.

key.name: menu-bar-padding
key.summary: Horizontal padding of each File/Edit title, in pixels
key.description: Room on each side of a title. Zero packs them against each other. 10 is what the stylesheet used to hard-code.

key.name: hide-overview-button
key.summary: Hide the Activities/overview button

key.name: clock-on-the-right
key.summary: Move the clock to the far right of the panel
key.description: GNOME centres the clock; macOS keeps it in the corner with the status icons to its left.

key.name: hide-power-button
key.summary: Hide the Quick Settings power icon

key.name: hide-panel-spacers
key.summary: Hide inactive GNOME status placeholders
key.description: Screen recording, screen sharing, dwell click, accessibility and keyboard layout indicators.

key.name: group-spotlight-with-quick-settings
key.summary: Keep the Search Light icon next to Quick Settings

key.name: gap-before-quick-settings
key.summary: Space to the left of the Quick Settings icons, in pixels
key.description: Separates them from whatever sits before them, such as a search icon.

key.name: gap-before-clock
key.summary: Space between the Quick Settings icons and the clock, in pixels

key.name: status-icon-padding
key.summary: Padding on each side of a status area item, in pixels
key.description: Lower values pack the icons and clock more tightly. Zero leaves no space at all between them.

key.name: show-search-icon
key.summary: Show a search icon on the right of the bar
key.description: Sits where macOS keeps Spotlight, to the left of the status icons.

key.name: search-opens
key.summary: What the search icon opens
key.description: GNOME's own search, the Search Light extension, or a command of your own. Falls back to GNOME's search whenever the choice is unavailable.

key.name: search-command
key.summary: Command the search icon runs when set to a custom command

key.name: show-system-settings
key.summary: Show System Settings item in System Menu

key.name: show-app-grid
key.summary: Show App Grid item in System Menu

key.name: show-software-center
key.summary: Show Software Center item

key.name: software-center-command
key.summary: Command for Software Center

key.name: show-system-monitor
key.summary: Show System Monitor item

key.name: system-monitor-command
key.summary: Command for System Monitor

key.name: show-terminal
key.summary: Show Terminal item

key.name: terminal-command
key.summary: Command for Terminal

key.name: show-extensions-app
key.summary: Show Extensions item

key.name: extensions-app-id
key.summary: Desktop file ID of the extensions manager app to launch

key.name: show-force-quit
key.summary: Show Force Quit App item

key.name: show-power-options
key.summary: Show Sleep/Restart/Shut Down items

key.name: show-lock-screen
key.summary: Show Lock Screen item

key.name: show-log-out
key.summary: Show Log Out item

key.name: show-recent-items
key.summary: Show the Recent Items submenu

key.name: recent-items-limit
key.summary: How many entries each Recent Items section lists
key.description: Applications, Documents and Servers are each limited to this many, as in macOS.

key.name: system-menu-custom-items
key.summary: JSON list of custom shell-command items added to the System Menu
key.description: Each entry: {label, value}. Appears as its own section at the bottom of the System Menu.

key.name: desktop-app-name
key.summary: Name shown for the file manager / desktop placeholder in the App menu
key.description: Used for File menu items such as "New X Window" while an app is focused. The App menu no longer uses this as a fallback when every window is minimized.

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Enable verbose error logging to the system journal
key.description: Off by default to avoid excessive logging; turn on temporarily when diagnosing an issue.
